#!/bin/bash
# LeafMC Installer for Pterodactyl
# Supported versions: 1.21.4, 1.21.5, 1.21.6, 1.21.7, 1.21.8, 1.21.9, 1.21.10, 1.21.11

apt-get update -y
apt-get install -y curl jq

LEAF_API="https://api.leafmc.one/v2/projects/leaf"

# Determine version
if [ -z "${LEAF_VERSION}" ] || [ "${LEAF_VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
  echo "Fetching available versions from LeafMC API..."
  AVAILABLE=$(curl -sSL "${LEAF_API}" | jq -r '.versions[]' | sort -V | tail -1)
  LEAF_VERSION="${AVAILABLE}"
  echo "Latest version: ${LEAF_VERSION}"
fi

echo "Using Minecraft version: ${LEAF_VERSION}"

# Determine build number
if [ -z "${BUILD_NUMBER}" ] || [ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" == "latest" ]; then
  echo "Fetching latest build for version ${LEAF_VERSION}..."
  BUILD_NUMBER=$(curl -sSL "${LEAF_API}/versions/${LEAF_VERSION}" | jq '.builds[-1]')
  echo "Latest build: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"
fi

echo "Using build number: ${BUILD_NUMBER}"

JAR_NAME="leaf-${LEAF_VERSION}-${BUILD_NUMBER}.jar"
DOWNLOAD_URL="${LEAF_API}/versions/${LEAF_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}/downloads/${JAR_NAME}"

echo "Downloading from: ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
curl -sSL -o /mnt/server/${SERVER_JARFILE} "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

if [ -f "/mnt/server/${SERVER_JARFILE}" ] && [ -s "/mnt/server/${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
  echo "Download successful: ${SERVER_JARFILE}"
else
  echo "ERROR: Download failed or file is empty!"
  exit 1
fi

echo "LeafMC ${LEAF_VERSION} build ${BUILD_NUMBER} installed successfully."
